crossRefs.note: Your vows are on me, God. I will give thank offerings to you.
Praise waits for you, God, in Zion. Vows shall be performed to you.
But most certainly, God has listened. He has heard the voice of my prayer.
Yahweh assigned my portion and my cup. You made my lot secure.
The lines have fallen to me in pleasant places. Yes, I have a good inheritance.
He will bless those who fear Yahweh, both small and great.
Then those who feared Yahweh spoke one with another; and Yahweh listened, and heard, and a book of memory was written…
but in every nation he who fears him and works righteousness is acceptable to him.

translations.web: For you, God, have heard my vows. You have given me the heritage of those who fear your name.
translations.bsb: For You have heard my vows, O God; You have given me the inheritance reserved for those who fear Your name.
translations.kjv: For thou, O God, hast heard my vows: thou hast given me the heritage of those that fear thy name.
translations.asv: For thou, O God, hast heard my vows: Thou hast given me the heritage of those that fear thy name.
